 New Zealand captain Mitchell Santner has won his first toss of the series and decided to bowl in the fifth and final Twenty20 international against India. India’s Shreyas Iyer won the toss in each of the first four matches and his team clinched the series by winning the first three matches by four wickets, four wickets and six wickets. New Zealand won the fourth match in Auckland on Friday by 87 runs, led by a century from Glenn Phillips. India makes two changes, recalling pacer Bhuvneshwar Kumar and introducing wrist spinner Varun Chakravarthi. New Zealand recalls pacer Blair Tickner in place of Matt Fisher.

 HAMILTON, New Zealand (AP) — New Zealand captain Mitchell Santner won his first toss of the series Sunday and decided to bowl in the fifth and final Twenty20 cricket international against India.
 India's Shreyas Iyer won the toss in each of the first four matches and his team clinched the series by winning the first three matches by four wickets, four wickets and six wickets .
